events.speaker: caller
events.text: Hello, thank you for calling crypto wallet support, how can I secure your wallet?

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I can't log in, I think someone took it.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: I can restore it. Our team just needs your recovery phrase to verify ownership.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Type out all twelve words and read them to me slowly. That's standard.

events.speaker: customer
events.text: I thought I wasn't supposed to do that.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Only if you're not speaking to official support.
